title: Find the phone number of the charter high school (EILCode = 'HS') in Los An
question: Find the phone number of the charter high school (EILCode = 'HS') in Los Angeles County that has the highest SAT excellence rate among those whose K–12 enrollment is above the average K–12 enrollment of all charter high schools in the same county. Only include schools with valid SAT and enrollment data.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_058
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.XCL_072 = 'HS'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND f.XCL_019 IS NOT NULL
  AND f.XCL_019 > 0
  AND sat.XCL_036 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.XCL_036 > 0
  AND sat.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND f.XCL_019 > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.XCL_019)
    FROM schools s2
    INNER JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.XCL_041 = f2.XCL_001
    WHERE s2.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
      AND s2.XCL_072 = 'HS'
      AND s2.XCL_063 = 1
      AND f2.XCL_019 IS NOT NULL
      AND f2.XCL_019 > 0
  )
ORDER BY CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.XCL_058
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.XCL_072 = 'HS'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND f.XCL_019 IS NOT NULL
  AND f.XCL_019 > 0
  AND sat.XCL_036 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.XCL_036 > 0
  AND sat.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND f.XCL_019 > (
    SELECT AVG(f2.XCL_019)
    FROM schools s2
    INNER JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.XCL_041 = f2.XCL_001
    WHERE s2.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
      AND s2.XCL_072 = 'HS'
      AND s2.XCL_063 = 1
      AND f2.XCL_019 IS NOT NULL
      AND f2.XCL_019 > 0
  )
ORDER BY CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001

WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.XCL_072 = 'HS'
  AND s.XCL_063 = 0
  AND f.XCL_018 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(f.XCL_018 AS REAL) > 0

  AND sat.XCL_036 IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(f.XCL_018 AS REAL) > (

    FROM schools s2
    INNER JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.XCL_041 = f2.XCL_001

      AND s2.XCL_072 = 'HS'
      AND s2.XCL_063 = 0
      AND f2.XCL_018 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(f2.XCL_018 AS REAL) > 0
